summary: Active exploitation of a GL.iNet cloud flaw that planted malware on routers and KVMs leads today, alongside a Ghostscript sandbox-escape RCE and an exploited ASP.NET anti-CSRF flaw with no fix, while AI-assisted intrusions hit a stock exchange and ten more organizations and breaches at Cleverbridge, Rackspace, Samsung Securities, KEPCO, and USDA round out the day.
